source: Displayed DOM values captured through the shared-workbench design selector and solver controls, compared with native-R fixtures. All 15 defaults and 41 solver workflows repeated after the visual correction.

interaction_checks.rapid_edits: Latest difference .6 won over .3; result 90 total, exports current.
interaction_checks.invalid_sd: SD zero clears old result and disables R export.
interaction_checks.plan_round_trip: Two downloaded named scenarios reopened and recalculated: 128 and 352 analyzable participants.
interaction_checks.r_download: The browser-downloaded script ran in native R and reproduced 176 per group / 352 total.
interaction_checks.csv_download: Named rows, allocation, raw power, complete parameters and engine versions inspected.
interaction_checks.report: Printable HTML visibly contains result, curve, assumptions, limits and R/pwr versions. PDF save itself not exercised.
interaction_checks.phone: 390px viewport, 375px content with no horizontal overflow. Paired design selection and edited-effect calculation completed.
interaction_checks.desktop: Shared Figura toolbar, analysis rail, Configuration and output panes inspected at 1280px; standard paper palette, no independent dark theme.
interaction_checks.scenario_restore: Saved independent-means scenario restored the design selector from paired measurements to two independent means.

limits: Numerical/browser parity within these models, not independent validation of their statistical appropriateness. The eight-case Python harness is separate.
